cards.meaning: boundary; limit; the extent of authority or jurisdiction
cards.example: Binago ng korte ang hangganan ng kanilang desisyon.
cards.exampleMeaning: The court changed the boundary of its decision-making authority.
cards.note: Mas pormal at legal/pampulitika ang gamit kaysa sa 'limitasyon' (na pangkalahatan, pang-araw-araw); ginagamit sa konteksto ng kapangyarihan ng isang institusyon o batas.
cards.tiesTo: Senate impeachment court lowers VP Duterte's conviction threshold from 16 votes to two-thirds of eligible senator-judges

cards.meaning: the act of easing or lightening a burden, restriction, or cost
cards.example: Layunin ng kasunduan ang pagpapagaan ng taripa sa mahigit 94% ng mga produkto.
cards.exampleMeaning: The agreement's goal is the easing of tariffs on more than 94% of product categories.
cards.note: Iba ito sa 'pag-aalis' (buong pagtanggal); ang 'pagpapagaan' ay nagpapahiwatig ng unti-unting pagbabawas ng bigat o hirap, hindi kinakailangang kumpletong pagtanggal — angkop kapag pinaghalo ang pagbawas at pag-aalis ng taripa sa iba't ibang kategorya.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines-EU free trade agreement announced Sept 22, tariffs cut/removed on 94%+ of product categories

cards.meaning: to indulge, appease, or tolerate a problem rather than confront it; to let something slide
cards.example: 监管机构选择姑息这家公司的债务问题。
cards.examplePinyin: Jiānguǎn jīgòu xuǎnzé gūxī zhè jiā gōngsī de zhàiwù wèntí.
cards.exampleMeaning: Regulators chose to look the other way on the company's debt problem.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register. Near-synonym 纵容 (zòngróng) also means to indulge/connive but carries a harsher moral judgment, closer to complicity; 姑息 is softer, closer to 'looking away.' Collocates naturally with 问题 (problem) and 危机 (crisis) — you indulge a problem, not a person, in this register.
cards.tiesTo: Chinese regulators privately tell banks to keep Vanke loans off non-performing-loan books

cards.meaning: so as not to; in order to avoid (introduces the negative outcome being prevented)
cards.example: 银行推迟处理这笔贷款，以免触发系统性风险。
cards.examplePinyin: Yínháng tuīchí chǔlǐ zhè bǐ dàikuǎn, yǐmiǎn chùfā xìtǒngxìng fēngxiǎn.
cards.exampleMeaning: Banks delayed handling the loan, so as not to trigger systemic risk.
cards.note: Advanced connective (HSK 4). Contrasts directly with 以便 (yǐbiàn, taught 2026-09-22) — 以便 sets up a positive goal you're working toward, 以免 sets up a negative outcome you're working away from; same grammatical slot, opposite orientation.
cards.tiesTo: Vanke forbearance-by-instruction — banks avoiding a systemic run on the developer
